hook.line: Oh no! My hiccup scattered all the stars!
hook.line_caption:
Oh no! My hiccup
scattered all the stars!

song:
One star, two stars,
twinkle way up high!

Three stars, four stars,
shining in the sky!

Five, six, seven,
sparkle, glow and zoom,

Eight, nine, ten,
stars around the moon!
celebrate: Ten stars! The sky is shiny again!
outro: Counting stars is out of this world! What should we count next? Tell me!
outro_caption:
Counting stars is out of this world!
What should we count next? Tell me!

youtube.title: Count the Stars! (HIC!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🌟 HIC! Noodle got the hiccups and all the stars flew out of the sky! Can you help count them back?

Count from 1 to 10 with Noodle, the nerdiest noodle bowl in space! Watch the stars zoom back one by one, sing the twinkly counting song, and stay till the end for a surprise visitor from outer space! 🪐

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Count from 1 to 10
✔️ See each number and its word (1 = ONE)
✔️ Sing a catchy counting song
✔️ Laugh along with Noodle!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 HIC! Oh no!
0:05 Let's count the stars!
0:22 Sing along!
0:40 Wait... who's that?
0:52 What should we count next?

💬 What should Noodle count next? Tell us in the comments!
